402100101.text: Huh. We haven't been back to the Akademiya in a while. It hasn't changed much, has it?

402100102.text: Well, since we've got some time... Wanna go to the House of Daena? Paimon wants to do some reading!

402100103.text: Excuse me? Who are you, and what have you done with Paimon?

402100105.text: Well, you're too late! The Paimon you know and love is no more!

402100106.text: You're looking at Paimon Plus! A new and improved treasure trove of travel know-how!

402100107.text: Paimon Plus would like to find some new books to peruse. A gracious Traveler like yourself wouldn't leave her companionless on her quest, right?

402100111.text: Oh, hey! It's Collei, and... Cyrus!

402100112.text: Wonder what's going on... Let's go see!

402100113.text: And the books? Abandoning the quest already?

402100115.text: You know what they say... Learning is a lifelong quest!

402100116.text: Which means there's always another chance to read a book. But, you never know when the next chance to reunite with an old friend will come along!

402100119.text: Hoho! Hello, you two. It's been a while. Looking to spend time with some old friends?

402100120.text: Hehe, yep! We saw some familiar faces, so we came to say hi!

402100201.text: Tighnari's place... Tighnari's place... Ah, here it is!

402100202.text: Cyno, Sethos! Looks like the whole gang's here! ...Oh, and Layla's here too!

402100203.text: But, oh... She doesn't look too good. Did something happen?

402100206.text: #Ah, Paimon, {NICKNAME}. It's good to see you.

402100207.text: I'd welcome you like a proper host, but I'm a bit busy at the moment. Apologies.

402100209.text: Ah, no need to look that worried.

402100210.text: My observations indicate Miss Layla's condition has improved quite a bit.

402100211.text: There's no danger to her mind. She's just fatigued and needs some rest.

402100212.text: Excuse me for a moment while I blend some calming incense. I'll let you two explain the situation.

402100214.text: What happened was, Sethos and a few members of the Temple of Silence rescued Layla, who was out in the desert trapped in a state of delirium.

402100215.text: She had to be "rescued"? That sounds bad...

402100216.text: That's all you're gonna say about it, Cyno? I mean, we don't want people jumping to conclusions.

402100217.text: That's all I can say about it. The person involved is unable to explain what happened to her, so we're limited in what we know.

402100218.text: Ugh... Sorry. My head... still dizzy...

402100219.text: The moons... The moons... Exactly how many are there...

402100221.text: She's been repeating that phrase over and over again, but she can't seem to remember what happened to her.

402100222.text: We tried a few things back at the Temple of Silence, but we couldn't recover her memories.

402100223.text: Her symptoms are kind of similar to researchers in the Satyavada Life state, so we brought her to Tighnari to see if our veteran Forest Watcher had any other ideas.

402100224.text: Tighnari is pretty much our last option, so let's hope he can help.

402100225.text: The good news is, even if restoring her memory is a no go, we can help with the headache at least. Djer was in a similar state when we found him, delirious and mumbling to himself, but he's more or less back to normal now.

402100226.text: Ah, sorry. I should give you some context first, huh...

402100227.text: We should let Miss Layla get some rest. Come with me, you two, and I'll introduce you to the other "victim" of this incident.

402100228.text: Good idea. I'll wait for Tighnari here and keep an eye on our patient.

402100301.text: *sigh* Who did the Ajilenakh Nut offend... I just don't get it...

402100302.text: Hey, Djer! Still musing about Ajilenakh Nuts, huh? Want me to have Cyno come over and tell some jokes? Might help distract you!

402100306.text: Well, sorry for interrupting the Ajilenakh talk, buddy. Next time, just say... "Ah, gee. Hey! Knock!"

402100312.text: Hold on, hold on. So, what's the deal with the Ajilenakh Nuts? Other than the bad Cyno jokes...

402100313.text: Hahaha, we'll get to that. But first, introductions are in order! This is Djer — a member of the Temple of Silence.

402100315.text: Of course. I'd never forget a participant in the Rite of Duels or the hero who saved Sumeru.

402100316.text: Awesome. Could you go over what happened to you one more time, Djer? Our valiant hero is gonna help us get to the bottom of this.

402100318.text: Might as well join since you're here, am I right?

402100319.text: Just hear him out. You're gonna want to uncover this mystery once you do — I'd bet on it.

402100320.text: Well, I was on an expedition in the desert not too long ago when I got caught in some quicksand.

402100321.text: Later, it became obvious it wasn't normal quicksand, because instead of sinking to my death, I fell into an undiscovered ruin.

402100322.text: In my panic, arms and legs flailing about, I suspect I touched some things I shouldn't have...

402100323.text: ...Because in that brief moment, an enormous amount of information came surging into my mind.

402100324.text: I would hesitate to even call it knowledge because my brain had no capacity to process the information.

402100325.text: To use an analogy, it would be like... Trying to stuff thousands of Ajilenakh Nuts into a small water skin without it bursting.

402100326.text: Sorry, sorry. Again with the Ajilenakh Nuts, I know..

402100327.text: It's fine. We're getting to that part of the story, anyway.

402100329.text: Well, just as I was on the verge of madness, a single phrase broke through the storm of thoughts in my head...

402100330.text: It was a man's voice saying, "don't eat Ajilenakh Nuts."

402100333.text: I know it's hard to believe, but that's what happened. I was saved by the phrase "don't eat Ajilenakh Nuts."

402100309.text: Oh, dear... another master of puns?

402100310.text: One of Cyno's card buddies, actually.

402100311.text: Ah, I think I might just take that as my cue to head back to the desert...

402100401.text: How are you feeling? Ah, but don't speak if it's too taxing.

402100402.text: It's fine. I'm much better now, thanks.

402100403.text: I feel like I haven't slept in two days... So, pretty much back to normal...

402100404.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa... That's your normal!?

402100406.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, Paimon... I thought I heard your voices earlier...

402100408.text: Huh? You don't have to apologize! You didn't do anything wrong!

402100409.text: Ah... No, I just mean... I think I'm about to disappoint you.

402100410.text: My head was kinda muddled earlier, but I still heard your conversation.

402100411.text: I know you're trying to figure out what happened to me, and I want to help...

402100412.text: But... I really don't remember anything.

402100414.text: No, I feel fine. The incense you made helped a lot.

402100415.text: I'm still hearing those words in my head, but other than that, I'm okay.

402100416.text: It's just... all I remember are those words. Everything else is a total blank.

402100417.text: One moment I was heading to the stargazing point I'd calculated, and the next, I was on my back in the sand, the same phrase playing over and over again in my mind...

402100418.text: How many moons are there in the sky?

402100420.text: Sethos, did your friend Djer suffer from memory loss too?

402100421.text: Not really. His memories are blurry, but there aren't huge gaps like this.

402100422.text: He remembers touching something, someone talking, a voice mentioning "Tulaytullah," and hearing a cat lead him to the exit.

402100425.text: Huh, now that you mention it, I think so? It was so soft, I thought I was imagining things...

402100426.text: Hmm... Which means, at the very least, what the two of you experienced while escaping the ruin is consistent.

402100427.text: A single sentence repeating in your heads, and the faint sound of a cat.

402100428.text: Still not a lot to go off of.

402100431.text: Oh, is your head hurting again, Layla?

402100433.text: *breathe out* No, I was just thinking... Maybe my memories are blank because I was sleepwalking at the time?

402100434.text: Sometimes, my friends and classmates tell me about things I don't remember doing, or places I don't remember going.

402100435.text: I don't talk about it a lot because, well... I don't even know how it happens. But I don't want my personal circumstances clouding your judgment.

402100436.text: So, I... just wanted to mention that.

402100437.text: Ah... I see. Well, thank you for telling us.

402100438.text: But, I don't think we need to dwell on that for now. We're gonna check out the site of the incident for ourselves, so that should help us come to our own conclusions.

402100442.text: Then, could I come too? I have to know what happened to me back there.

402100443.text: Sure, but on one condition — you need to be in tip-top shape before we head out.

402100444.text: If your condition isn't stable enough before then, we'll have to figure out something else.

402100446.text: Well, I'm more concerned about Tighnari... You sure you'll be alright in the desert?

402100447.text: You say that like I'll evaporate on first contact with sand or something.

402100448.text: Call it... curiosity. If this concerns my ancestors, I want to figure out what's going on.

402100449.text: Anyway, as long as I take things slow when the sun's out, I should be fine with the right preparation.

402100450.text: Besides, it's a good idea to have a doctor on hand in case of emergencies.

402100451.text: So long as our doctor doesn't become the emergency.

402100452.text: Well, if that happens, I suppose I'll just have to rely on the kindness of my entourage to haul me back home.

402100453.text: Alright, well, that all sounds good to me. Let's meet in two days like we agreed.

402100454.text: Sethos finds a map and marks the location for you.

402100455.text: Djer and I are gonna head back to the Temple of Silence and do some research in the meantime. See you in a couple days!

402100457.text: What about you, Layla? If you feel like you need more rest, I can arrange a room for you to stay in.

402100458.text: O—Oh, um, no need! I've asked enough of you as it is...

402100459.text: Besides, I feel a lot better. I should make it back to my dorm, no problem.

402100460.text: You sure? Don't push it too hard, or you might end up sleepwalking along the way...

402100462.text: I have other things I need to do, anyway. Like letting my advisor and classmates know that I'm fine, adjusting my stargazing schedule, things like that...

402100463.text: If I don't get it all done, I doubt I'll be able to sit still, let alone stay here and get some rest...

402100465.text: You know what? I'll make sure she gets back.

402100466.text: Ah, a much better idea. Thank you, Traveler.

402100467.text: Of course, if anything starts to feel off, come back for a checkup right away!

402100468.text: You'd better listen to him, Layla, or he'll feed you tasteless slop as a punishment.

402100469.text: Punishment? You're the one who caught a cold. You're supposed to eat light when that happens.

402100470.text: Besides, with your nose stuffed up like that, you couldn't taste anything to begin with.

402100472.text: And here I thought it was an intaste-tinal issue.

402100473.text: ...Should've seen that coming. You're off the clock, so now it's time for puns, huh?

402100475.text: Don't worry, Paimon. I understand. If you want me to stop, then...

402100477.text: You'll have to call a plumber. Tell them someone's gotta "pipe" down...

402100479.text: Ugh... This is getting more insufferable by the second!

402100480.text: Put a sock in it already. Please...

402100481.text: Got it, Paimon, one "sock-in" coming right up~

402100485.text: You win, okay? Let's just get out of here... please.

402100506.text: Oh no, looks like Paimon's caught the brain bug too — she can't stop thinking about those two things!

402100507.text: Paimon's gotta clear her head. But how...

402100509.text: The cafe over there! Why don't we head over for a quick pick-me-up?

402100512.text: S—Sorry. I feel kinda tired all of a sudden...

402100513.text: Wait, is it because of all Paimon's muttering just now?

402100514.text: Ah, sorry, sorry... Um, the coffee will be Paimon's treat, okay?

402100515.text: So generous all of a sudden...

402100516.text: Hey, you make it sound like Paimon's stingy or something!

402100517.text: Hmph, well, she'll just have to show you her... true colors! Yeah, starting now!

402100518.text: #You sit tight and take care of Layla, {NICKNAME}. Paimon's gonna get us some snacks and coffee!

402100519.text: Be right back! Don't go anywhere in the meantime!

402100520.text: *sigh*... She's pushing herself again, as always.

402100523.text: I apologize for the sudden emergence, but I didn't have any other options...

402101301.text: #It seems your jokes have improved with practice, {NICKNAME}.

402101303.text: Absolutely. Finally, someone to share the load.

402101304.text: ...Ah, you know what? Collei's helping out the Akademiya, but I haven't had the chance to check on her. Why don't you do me a favor, and... go do that.

402101305.text: Hold on, I thought you were having me over for dinner?

402100602.text: (Quicksand near the ideal viewing spot? Wasn't expecting that...)

402100603.text: (Looks like Layla's been under a lot of pressure lately. She hasn't been paying attention to her surroundings...)

402100604.text: (But... why would quicksand lead to a place like this?)

402100605.text: (Well, all in all, looks like a common desert ruin... Guess there's nothing to do but try to find a way out.)

402100606.text: (Oh, Layla... What have you gotten yourself into this time...)

402101201.text: There are records in the Temple of Silence that speak of the ancient desert peoples' love of raising cats. Perhaps I encountered some ancestral cat spirit, long since passed on?

subQuests.subQuestName: Activate the device to open the door

402100701.text: How many moons are there in the sky?

402100703.text: ("How many moons are there in the sky?")

402100704.text: (How many moons are there in the sky?)

402100705.text: (Okay. Information isn't rushing into my brain anymore. That's good.)

402100706.text: (How many moons are there in the sky?)

402100707.text: (My head hurts, but there are no more dark spots in my vision, and I can see in front of me. Still...)

402100708.text: (How many moons are there in the sky?)

402100709.text: (What's going on? The same thought keeps popping into my head. What does it mean...)

402100710.text: (How many moons are there in the sky?)

402100713.text: (...A cat? I think there was one earlier, too...)

402100715.text: (I'm not hearing things — it really is a cat! But what is it doing here...)

402100716.text: (How many moons... are there... No. Stop it!)

402100718.text: (Does it want me to follow its cries?)

402100719.text: (Well, it's not like I've got other options. Come on, Layla. You can do this...)

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the cat's guidance to leave the ruins

402100901.text: Oh, and Kaveh, your coffee beans... You were too busy glaring at Alhaitham, you almost forgot them.

402100903.text: Well, we're pretty close to the Akademiya now. I should be fine from here.

402100904.text: Thanks for the coffee, Paimon. I feel much better now!

402100907.text: Right. I'll follow the doctor's orders... Or try to, at least...

402100908.text: With the blessing of the stars, I hope we all get a good night's sleep.

402100801.text: ...And so, I followed the cat's cries to find my way out.

402100802.text: It was quite a kind creature... It didn't even leave until the other me started to wake up.

402100805.text: Thinking back, it all started when I touched that device.

402100806.text: I've heard fellow students talk about it before... how the desert is full of objects that do strange things.

402100807.text: Sometimes, it's just a minor inconvenience. But, other times, devices like that can cause massive trouble.

402100808.text: I know exactly what you mean.

402100809.text: Ah, of course. I forgot how much adventuring experience you have.

402100810.text: Still, carrying an umbrella doesn't mean you can't get soaked, so just... Be careful, and stay away from unknown devices.

402100812.text: No need to thank me. You and Layla are about to head into dangerous territory together. You need to be safe, so she can be safe.

402100813.text: Well, I think that about sums it up.

402100814.text: Ah, and just in time — your coffee's here.

402100816.text: Seeing Paimon precariously try to keep her balance, you rush over to help her out.

402100900.text: When you turn around, Layla is rubbing her eyes sleepily.

402109901.text: (I think this door can be opened using the device next to it...)

402109903.text: (Ugh! What was that! My head... it hurts...)

402109904.text: (Is Layla... waking up? ...No, that's not it...!)

402109905.text: (What... What's going on... It's... too much.)

402109907.text: (The ground is... where am I? It's... spinning...)
